results.rationale: Consistency: The lips, gums, existing teeth, peach background, highlights and composition remain visually unchanged outside the requested tooth repair. Instruction: One upper gap is filled with a matching tooth; a complete result would fill both visible gaps, but the lower gap remains, so the request is only partially fulfilled. Quality: Structure, illustrated shading, outlines and surface textures are coherent and clean; the remaining tooth gap is a plausible depicted condition rather than a rendering artifact.

Consistency: The wooden tabletop and its major grain markings remain recognizable, but the spoon bowl has been rotated and moved from the upper-left area to the lower-left area, a clear unrequested change to the existing object placement. Instruction: The short stem becomes a long continuous handle; a completed spoon should have a visible finished handle end, whereas this handle runs beyond the right edge, leaving its completion unshown. This is partial compliance. Quality: The spoon has smooth continuous contours and believable ceramic shading, with coherent wood grain and contact shadow; the frame crop is not itself a generation artifact.
